desc.zh: 先筛掉任一端被封禁的行，再按天计算取消率。
desc.en: Filter out trips with either endpoint banned, then compute a daily cancellation rate.

complexity: O(T + U) expected time; O(T + U) space

concepts.name: Eligibility join
concepts.description: Keep a trip only when both its client and driver are unbanned.

concepts.name: Daily conditional rate
concepts.description: For each day, divide cancelled eligible requests by all eligible requests.

concepts.name: Pandas groupby
concepts.description: Map the invariant to the official DataFrame callable.
